sections.heading: Core Gameplay Mechanics
sections.body:

The game board is a 6x6 grid, and you can swap two candies to create a match. The game also features power-ups and boosters that can be used to clear the board and earn more points.

The game's goal is to eat all the candies on the board by creating matches of three or more of the same color.
